changeinfo.changes:
• Maniac Mansion - added multiple save slots and support for saving anywhere.
  • Cross-Save - added an option to turn off cross-save for players who do not wish to synchronize save data over the Internet. Turning this feature off may help players who experience problems due to Internet connectivity issues.
  • Audio - added a setting to toggle between remastered and classic sound effects.
  • Audio - fixed "FIRE!!!" voice over line not playing if subtitles are turned off.
  • Audio - fixed a classic game bug where Bernard would say one of Laverne's lines in the Lobby in a specific situation.
  • Art - fixed a sorting issue with Green Tentacle in the future during a cutscene.
  • Art - removed a stray white pixel on Laverne's shoe in a certain animation.
  • Commentary - fixed some subtitle typos.
  • Concept Art - removed the in-game unlock notification. Check the pause menu to see when new concept art has been unlocked.
  • Controls - added the ability to skip dialog lines by tapping on the touchscreen.
  • Controls - added a way to trigger object highlight using touch. Hold two fingers on the touchscreen to use.
  • UI - fixed a bug in verb dial mode where a certain inventory object's morph animation didn't play correctly during a certain puzzle.
  • UI - added touch UI for opening the pause menu in DotT verb bar mode and in Maniac Mansion.
